name: University of Agder (UiA)
summary: Public university on Norway’s south coast; five English bachelor’s, from esports in Grimstad to English, development and music in Kristiansand.

handoff.label: How to apply to degree programmes (international)

ib.text: The IB Diploma meets the entry requirement, and English at any grade that passes, SL or HL, covers English. The two music degrees add an entrance exam.

apply.via: Søknadsweb; Nordic citizens use Samordna opptak

dates.label: Music degrees: application deadline in Søknadsweb
Application web opens for EU/EEA and Nordic applicants
EU/EEA deadline: Academic Esports, English, Global Development Studies
Nordic citizens: Samordna opptak deadline for the same three
First results for EU/EEA applicants (second batch 10 July) (yearly date)

programmes.name: Academic Esports
programmes.about: Esports as the way into training and performance, physiology and psychology, marketing, economics, content production and game technology; the last semester specialises in play, industry, innovation or education and health.
programmes.selectionNote: Every qualified Samordna opptak applicant got an offer in 2026, in both quotas; UiA does not say how it ranks its EU/EEA Søknadsweb route.

programmes.name: Classical Music Performance
programmes.ib: Audition on your main instrument plus aural and theory tests; a recorded audition and online tests are possible from abroad.
programmes.about: Performance on a classical main instrument, or two main areas across genres, with solo repertoire, orchestra, choir and chamber music, plus aural training, music history, analysis and music technology.
programmes.selectionNote: The entrance exam decides: an audition on your main instrument, aural and theory tests and an interview. From abroad, send a certified 25-minute recording.

programmes.name: Electronic Music
programmes.ib: Entrance exam: 10–15 minutes of your own produced work plus a written statement by 15 January. The programme page says 1 March; the exam page says apply by 15 December.
programmes.about: Music production, sound design, composition and arranging with electronic music theory and history, from electronic pop and club music to live electronics, ambient and experimental work, with one-to-one supervision.
programmes.selectionNote: Judged on your own produced music and a written statement, for artistic potential and your own ideas rather than technical polish.

programmes.name: English
programmes.ib: Taught in English and Norwegian. UiA recommends English beyond the one-year upper-secondary minimum; no subject is required.
programmes.about: English language, literature and culture of Britain and the USA, with training in close analysis and academic writing and a study trip to York in the first spring semester. Taught in English and Norwegian.
programmes.selectionNote: Every qualified Samordna opptak applicant got an offer in 2026, in both quotas; UiA does not say how it ranks its EU/EEA Søknadsweb route.

programmes.name: Global Development Studies
programmes.about: Development, international relations and global change from an interdisciplinary social-science angle, with a fourth semester on exchange and final-semester fieldwork with partner universities in developing countries.
programmes.selectionNote: Every qualified Samordna opptak applicant got an offer in 2026, in both quotas; UiA does not say how it ranks its EU/EEA Søknadsweb route.

notes: Academic Esports is taught mainly on the Grimstad campus; UiA says each class also has one day on the Kristiansand campus.
In 2026 every qualified Samordna opptak applicant to Academic Esports was offered a place.
Global Development Studies sets the fourth semester aside for exchange, with Erasmus+ grants available.
